relationships.subject: DCPIB
relationships.evidence_quote: DCPIB, an inhibitor of LRRC8A, greatly alleviated chronic visceral pain.

relationships.subject: LRRC8A
relationships.evidence_quote: we observed a significant decrease in ATP concentration after inhibiting LRRC8A in the ACC

relationships.subject: neonatal maternal deprivation
relationships.evidence_quote: The western blotting results revealed that the protein expression of LRRC8A was significantly upregulated in the ACC of NMD male mice compared to CON male mice

key_findings: LRRC8A is upregulated in ACC neurons of NMD male mice and ACC DCPIB relieves visceral pain.
LRRC8A upregulation is region-, sex- and model-specific; ACC ATP rises and falls with LRRC8A inhibition.
